metadata.title: Galaxy Rotation and Rapid Supermassive Black Hole Binary Coalescence

notes: No eligible stars: the paper studies simulated SMBH binaries in galaxy models and only mentions hypervelocity-star production generically (T:p1-b7). It does not identify any individual Galactic unbound star or follow up a previously identified candidate. Labels such as S0-S2, A0-A4, B0-B4, and C0-C3 are simulation runs (T:p3-b0), and M87, NGC4472, and NGC4486A are reference galaxies (T:p6-b3).
